default_information_gate: four15minute bins:raw_coarse with physical timing unknown; >=40 complete bins:CPOP operational default, optionally guarded template selected by observed-bin validation
selection_rule: 5fold interleaved1minute blocks; template validation squared error must be at least10percent lower than CPOP and block mean improvement greater than1block-SE; finite successful optimizer and prediction required
decision_rule_status: pre-frozen heuristic, not error-probability or confidence guarantee
development_admission: guarded policy admitted only if all6 development seed-block RMSE differences <=0 and aggregate RMSE improves at least1percent against conservative default; otherwise shipped default is conservative CPOP plus coarse raw gate
test_use: one evaluation after policy frozen, no new threshold/parameter search; retain all negative outcomes
domain: task0..30min/request1.5kW, notice-15, complete window-15..45, delta10sec/1min/15min; finite signed meter readings accepted and counted without clipping, nonnegative reference; positive declared sigma
data: new seed realizations of the previous8-mechanism evaluator, formulas copied into this work folder; formal package does not import work Python
energy: all methods share raw reference-power integral; cumulative and longest continuous threshold time remain distinct
inference: 20 independent seed blocks; variants paired, not independent; no physical timing or process confidence interval claim
runtime: original CPOP1.0.10 with grid=x, beta2log(n_train), sd given, exact pruning; full and CV cases batched in one R process where practical; unavailable R explicitly degrades raw_F0, never silently substitutes template
stop: one development admission and one new holdout evaluation; no report writing
